description:
## Problem
`benchbox run` and the other commands that generate data or execute queries take no host lock, so a benchmark started by hand or by an agent can overlap a test session or UAT sweep. Turning the lock on unconditionally would change behavior for every PyPI user and serialize legitimate parallel cloud runs.

## Change
1. Add an opt-in setting read from the current user's BenchBox configuration under `$HOME` (so isolated test HOMEs never enable it) plus an env override `BENCHBOX_HOST_LOCK=1|0`. Default off.
2. When enabled, these commands take the lock, run admission and start the watchdog for their whole lifetime: `run` (not `--dry-run`), `run-official`, `datagen`, `convert`, `compare` when it executes queries, `compare-dataframes`. Commands that only read results or print help never acquire.
3. Child processes and in-process re-entry use the owner/re-entry rules from `heavy-guard-lock-core-20261030`, so a `benchbox run` launched by a locked pytest or UAT session never waits on its parent.
4. Windows: no `pwd`; the lock-core path fallback applies; the watchdog uses the non-macOS reader.
5. User docs: document the setting, the env override, the wait/bypass variables and the watchdog modes on the existing CLI or operations page; add a `changelog.d/` fragment.

## Decision gates
- D1 (resolved by owner instruction to proceed with recommended defaults): opt-in, default off.
- D2 (resolved): when enabled, cloud-platform runs also lock, because data generation runs locally.
- G1 (stop condition): find the existing user-config loader first. If BenchBox has no user-level config file, use only the env override plus a documented one-line config file, and record the choice in the PR; do not invent a second config system.
- G2 (stop condition): if `compare` cannot tell whether it will execute queries before it starts, lock the whole command and record why.

## Guardrails
- Linked worktree; stage explicitly; `[COMMENT-POLICY-001]`; `[CHANGELOG-001]`.
- CLI dry runs must stay lock-free and keep propagating explicit phases.
- Verification runs use `--dry-run` or the smallest scale with duckdb; no runs above scale 0.01.
- Adapter SDK imports stay lazy: acquiring the lock must not import platform SDKs.

## Non-goals
Per-phase locking; engine-level memory limits.
